answer: The comet register is checked at draw time, opal lists the eligible set, and sparrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 54 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 54 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 214 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
